ev.q: It centered on Dodge City, Kansas, in the 1870s, during the settlement of the American West
Set in Dodge City, Kansas during the years following the American Civil War
Gunsmoke was the dramatization of the American epic legend of the west
Most episodes involve disruptions caused by those arriving from outside Dodge City
A total of 635 episodes were aired over its 20-year run
At the end of its run in 1975
